_comment: Source list for daily AI report. type: rss | tavily | url. tier: 1=vendor, 4=devtool. max_items caps per-source noise. NOTE: gh-releases removed — local gh CLI is bound to SAP enterprise GitHub and cannot read public repos; use Tavily on GitHub release pages instead.

sources.name: Claude Blog (claude.com/blog)
sources.notes: Primary venue for Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude product announcements. Distinct from anthropic.com/news (corporate/policy) — must scan both.

sources.name: Claude Resources / Articles
sources.notes: Agent-building / applied-engineering articles (e.g. 'when to fold subagents into your main agent loop') that live under /resources/articles, NOT on /blog. Added 2026-10-28 after such an article was missed. For a listing page, Tavily extract may be stale — use tavily_search on claude.com/resources if needed.

sources.name: Anthropic Institute
sources.notes: Anthropic Institute publishes broad think-pieces on AI/economy/governance — distinct from /news and /research

sources.name: Anthropic Frontier Red Team
sources.notes: Anthropic security research blog — referenced by Glasswing/security posts

sources.name: Meta AI Research Blog
sources.notes: Distinct Meta property from ai.meta.com/blog — hosts FAIR/research posts (e.g. muse-wonder) that never appear on the product blog. Added 2026-10-13 after a research.meta.ai post was missed.

sources.name: AWS What's New (AI/ML)
sources.notes: 2026-10-14: switched from tavily-search to the dated AWS What's New RSS feed. The search variant kept returning undated results that could not be window-filtered (flagged degraded 10-13). This feed carries per-item postDateTime, so the 24h window filter now works. Filter to AI/ML keywords since the feed is all-categories.

sources.name: GitHub Trending (AI/ML)
sources.notes: Daily GitHub trending list — filter to AI/ML keywords. Skip generic devops/security repos.

sources._section: Tier 2 — Research / community (high-bar: items must score >= 4 to be included; cap 3 total across all Tier 2)

sources.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
sources.notes: Pre-ranked by community votes. Pull top items, but ONLY include if score >= 4 in ranking step. Most days yield 0-2 items.

sources.name: Simon Willison's Blog
sources.notes: High-trust single-curator AI commentary. Doesn't post daily — quiet days are normal.

sources._section: Tier 1 — Social: X.com via Playwright MCP (logged-out fetch, no auth required, ~5 sec/account). If Playwright fails for any account, log it in 'failed sources' and continue.

sources.name: X: @GoogleResearch
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-28 after the Harness² miss (reports/2026-10-19.html post-mortem): Google Cloud AI Research work (e.g. google-research/harness2) never appears on research.google/blog or the DeepMind handle and slipped the pipeline entirely. This handle is the direct first-party path for arXiv/GitHub-launched Google Research artifacts. Watch whether it posts frequently enough to be worth the fetch.

sources.name: X: @sama
sources.notes: Sam Altman — high signal-to-noise ratio for OpenAI direction

sources.name: X: @karpathy
sources.notes: Andrej Karpathy — substantive when he posts, doesn't post daily

sources.name: X: @simonw
sources.notes: Simon Willison — daily AI commentary; complements his blog source

sources.name: X: @trq212
sources.notes: Thariq Shihipar — Anthropic Claude Code engineer, author of 'Lessons from building Claude Code: How we use skills'. Posts infrequently (weeks/months between posts) but high signal — worth checking even if often quiet.

sources.name: X: @swyx
sources.notes: Latent Space's swyx — AI engineering ecosystem signal
